items.title: Explanation on the Basis of Quantum Theory (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Explanation on the Basis of Quantum Theory: a main subheading of 18.2 Photoelectric Effect, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 121-123.

blocks.text: Einstein ne Planck ka quantization wala khayal aage barhaya: roshni quanta, yani energy ke chhote packets jinhein photons kehte hain, ki shakal mein emit (kharij) ya absorb (jazb) hoti hai. Frequency f wale har photon ki energy:

blocks.alt: Photoelectrons ki K.E.max aur roshni ki frequency f ka graph. Seedhi line f-axis (mehwar) ko threshold frequency fo par kaatti hai aur daen taraf oopar jati hai; axis ke neeche yeh dashed line ban kar K.E.max axis tak jati hai.
blocks.caption: Aap ki maloomat ke liye: photoelectrons ki zyada se zyada kinetic energy aur roshni ki frequency ka graph; aik khaas frequency fo se neeche photoemission nahi hota (kitab ke box wale graph ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Line ka slope (dhalwan) h hai, har metal ke liye aik jaisa, kyunke (K.E.)max = hf − φ. Line f-axis ko fo par kaatti hai; dashed hissa peeche barhaya jaye to K.E.max axis ko −φ par kaatta hai. Kitab ke box ka text 'below a certain frequency f' likhti hai; sahi 'fo' hai.

Ek photon ko metal ki surface ka sirf ek electron absorb karta hai. Metal ki surface se nikalne ke liye electron ko kam se kam ek khaas energy chahiye jise work function φ kehte hain. Agar photon ki energy kafi ho to electron foran nikal jata hai. Photon ki energy ka ek hissa electron ko metal se azad karne mein lagta hai aur baqi hissa electron ki kinetic energy ban jata hai. Yani:

blocks.text_alt: Incident photon energy − Work function = (K.E.)max of photoelectron

blocks.text: Ise Einstein's photoelectric equation kehte hain.
Jab photoelectron ki (K.E.)max zero ho to frequency f threshold frequency f₀ ke barabar hoti hai. Is liye Eq. 18.5 yeh ban jati hai:
Is liye Einstein ki photoelectric equation yun bhi likh sakte hain:

Yaad rahe ke har nikalne wale electron ke paas maximum kinetic energy nahi hoti. Kuch electrons seedhe metal ki surface se nikal aate hain aur kuch bahar aane se pehle atoms se takra kar energy kho dete hain. Equation 18.7 sirf un electrons par lagu hoti hai jo poori bachi hui (surplus) energy le kar nikalte hain.
Photoelectric effect ki explanation par Albert Einstein ko 1921 mein physics ka Nobel Prize mila.

Agar hum maanein ke roshni sirf waves hai aur us ki energy wavefront par barabar phaili hui hai, to photoelectric effect samjhaya nahi ja sakta. Yeh sirf tab samajh aata hai jab roshni ko energy ke chhote packets (photons) maanein. Is tarah yeh effect roshni ki particle nature (zarre jaisi fitrat) dikhata hai.

blocks.title: Example 18.1
blocks.problem: 450 nm wavelength wali neeli roshni ke ek photon ki energy eV mein nikalein.
steps: Wavelength λ = 450 nm = 450 × 10⁻⁹ m; h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s

blocks.title: Example 18.2
blocks.problem: 577 nm wavelength wali peeli (yellow) roshni cesium metal ki surface par parti hai. Stopping voltage 0.25 V hai. Nikalein: (a) photoelectrons ki maximum K.E. (b) cesium ka work function.
steps: (b) Photoelectric equation: hf − φ = ½mv²max, is liye φ = hc/λ − (K.E.)max

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Example 18.2 mein kitab 577 nm ko 5.77 × 10⁻⁹ m likhti hai; sahi 5.77 × 10⁻⁷ m (yani 577 × 10⁻⁹ m) hai. Hisaab mein 577 × 10⁻⁹ m hi istemal hua hai, is liye jawab 0.25 eV aur 1.9 eV sahi hain.

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text:
Electromagnetic radiation aur matter (maddah) ka interaction (aapas ka amal) photon ki energy par depend karta hai:
(i) Kam energy (0.5 MeV se kam) par zyada tar photoelectric effect hota hai.
(ii) Intermediate (darmiyani) energy par zyada tar Compton effect hota hai.
(iii) Zyada energy (1.2 MeV se zyada) par zyada tar pair production hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Roshni ki intensity barhane se photocurrent kyun barhta hai lekin photoelectrons ki maximum kinetic energy kyun nahi barhti?
blocks.explanation: Tez roshni har second zyada photons lati hai, is liye zyada electrons nikalte hain aur current barhta hai. Lekin har photon ki energy ab bhi hf hi hai, is liye har electron ki maximum energy hf − φ wahi rehti hai.

items: Photoelectrons sirf threshold frequency f₀ se zyada frequency par nikalte hain.
½mv²max = V₀e (18.4); hf − φ = ½mv²max (18.5); φ = hf₀ (18.6); (K.E.)max = hf − hf₀ (18.7).
Intensity electrons ki tadaad, frequency un ki maximum energy tay karti hai.
Photoelectric effect roshni ki particle nature (zarre jaisi fitrat) dikhata hai.
